A committee checks preparation and English at approximately B2; an interview or test may be required, except the page exempts graduates with at least 90/110. title: Mathematics, Computer Science and Physics study prospectus 2026/27

evidence: For second-cycle courses taught in Italian or English, non-EU residents and/or holders of foreign qualifications used Elix-Forms pre-evaluation from 1 February to 31 May 2026, with a non-refundable €20 fee and academic review within 30 working days. title: Additional Notice on tuition, contributions and exemptions 2026/27
evidence: The 2026/27 notice sets the annual university contribution from €0 to €2,000, stamp duty €16 and regional tax €120–€160, subject to conditions and exemptions; payment is normally in three instalments. It is a prior-cycle framework, not a 2027/28 quote.

title: Useful information for international students: fees and benefits
evidence: The international-student page reports 2026/27 fees between €16 and €2,076 and three instalments. evidence: The call covers eligible students at Udine and Trieste. It requires enrollment plus economic and merit eligibility; foreign households use ISEE parificato. title: ARDiS 2026/27 application opening and deadlines
evidence: Online regional-benefit applications opened 15 July 2026. The scholarship deadline was 17 September at 13:00; new-student housing applications closed 27 August at 13:00. These are closed prior-cycle dates only.

title: Computer Engineering MSc profile
evidence: The official profile lists the two-year English-taught Computer Engineering Master's at Bari. Current curricula are Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, Cybersecurity and Cloud, and Cyberphysical Systems. This is prior-cycle profile evidence only.

evidence: Regulation identifies Class LM-32, 120 ECTS, two-year standard duration, English instruction, and three curricula. title: Admission to two-year Master's degrees 2026/27
evidence: The mandatory prior-to-enrolment Esse3 process accepted one MSc preference per candidate after the bachelor's degree. 2026/27 application windows ran 28 July–15 September, then monthly windows through 10 May 2027. Eligible applicants enrolled 22 September 2026–20 May 2027; admission and enrollment are separate stages.

title: General overview for international candidates 2026/27

These are 2026/27 procedures only.

title: English B2 assessment for Master's degrees 2026/27
evidence: Computer Engineering is included in the 2026/27 Master's language-assessment list. The online English test has 30 questions, lasts 15 minutes and requires at least 21/30; applicants may register up to three working days before published test sessions. This calendar is prior-cycle only.

title: Tuition and fee information 2026/27
evidence: The 2026/27 calculator is ISEE-based and does not include merit reductions, exemptions or penalties. The annual all-inclusive contribution depends on the fee regulation and student circumstances.

title: Student fees and contributions regulations 2026/27
evidence: The annual all-inclusive contribution is income- and eligibility-dependent; it is zero in the no-tax area at ISEE ≤€26,000 when applicable criteria are satisfied and is capped at €2,257.60 for ISEE ≥€90,000 or absent eligible ISEE, before any late-payment or study-progress penalties. title: ADISU Puglia benefits and scholarship call 2026/27
